summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to the Iceberg-Spark integration, including improvements for Spark 4.1 and async reader capabilities. Proposals for adding collation support and fine-grained access control have also been introduced, alongside discussions on storage credential refresh mechanisms and the addition of relative paths to the specification.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal for collation support in Iceberg specification
Discussion on adding 404 response for /v1/config endpoint
Enhancements to storage credential refresh mechanism
